text: S634 mapped the same five missing Polo CUT vertices in all three pinned CLO outputs to current-product `back.neckline`, `backCollar`, and `backCollarBase` allowance samples. Their short CUT steps arise near a one-centimeter allowance and tight sampled curvature; the mismatch remains above the unchanged 0.001 cm gate. The evidence does not justify deleting geometry or establish CLO internals. No gate/hold changes. S635 will test only coordinate-identical CUT entity re-encoding in CLO Standard import and inspect native geometry before export. See E-G04-S634-EXIT.
